title: docs(adr-0035): note the overview body-table order after the open field sections
body:
Part of #35742

## What changes

Adds one dated, add-only note to ADR-0035 (`docs/adr/0035-config-driven-master-detail.md`), directly under the 2026-11-19 amendment (#35597). No existing text changes.

The note records the overview order that PR #35824 shipped for #35742. The 11-19 amendment's clause "under the header strip and above the field sections" no longer holds. The details column now reads, top to bottom:

1. the header strip (key fields and the stage bar);
2. the field sections drawn open;
3. the body tables, in the parent's `relatedLists` order;
4. the field sections drawn closed that follow the last open one.

The note also records these cases:
- A closed section between two open ones keeps its place.
- When every section is drawn closed, the tables come last.
- A field group whose `relatedList` names a table still places it.
- An object with no stage bar and no key fields opens on its own fields.
- The host's "More details" opens expanded, so it stays before the tables. This is seat ruling (2), 2026-11-20 10:12Z.

## Why

The seat ruled on 2026-11-20 at 10:12Z that the ADR text must match the shipped order, as part of #35742's done-criteria. It also ruled that the note goes in its own small PR, so that #35824 stayed off the governed path.

## Verification

- `git diff origin/main` is +14 / −0 in one file. The note sits after the 11-19 amendment's last line.
- `check-governed-merges --branch` reads `docs/adr/**`, so the PR is governed (Tier H). It lands by the maintainer's hand or an authorized approval.
- The order stated matches `bodyTablePlacement` in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` on main, with the pins listed in #35824.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
